llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化制造的CoCr合金的磨损性能，但与用户的研究方向（如应力屏蔽、疲劳、骨整合）不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on wear of dental alloys, not on porous structure for stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue, or osseointegration relevant to hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估SLM制造CoCr合金的磨损性能
summary_zh.method: 进行二体磨损试验，比较SLM与铸造和激光烧结合金
summary_zh.result: SLM CoCr表现出可比或更好的耐磨性

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the wear behavior of CoCr alloy fabricated by selective laser melting for dental applications.
summary_en.method: Two-body wear tests were conducted comparing SLM CoCr with cast and laser-sintered CoCr alloys.
summary_en.result: SLM CoCr exhibited comparable or superior wear resistance to conventionally fabricated alloys.
summary_en.validation: Wear testing under controlled conditions with multiple specimens.
